contractMigrations.name: 20260804120000_auth_password_actions

contractMigrations.name: 20260805010000_harden_tournament_invite_lifecycle

contractMigrations.name: 20260805020000_refresh_token_families
contractMigrations.reason: Makes RefreshToken.familyId mandatory after backfill; the prior API does not populate that column when it creates refresh sessions.

contractMigrations.name: 20260805021000_idp_encrypted_credential_storage
contractMigrations.reason: Changes the IDP credential column type before a manual encryption backfill whose plaintext-zero state an old API writer cannot preserve.

contractMigrations.name: 20260805030000_broadcast_capability_lifecycle
contractMigrations.reason: Drops Organization.broadcastKey, which the prior API reads and writes.

contractMigrations.name: 20260805070000_widget_capability_lifecycle

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260804230000_match_publication_boundary
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Adds fail-closed publication flags whose false default makes every existing match and tournament private until explicitly reviewed and published.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805010000_harden_tournament_invite_lifecycle
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Hashes existing invite credentials and assigns createdAt plus seven days as their expiry, which can immediately expire historical pending invites.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805020000_refresh_token_families
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Backfills every refresh token family identifier and creates indexes over the rewritten rows, requiring reviewed lock and authentication-session impact acceptance.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805021000_idp_encrypted_credential_storage
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Widening the credential column enables the manual encryption transition; old writers must remain stopped until the existing plaintext count is verified as zero.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805030000_broadcast_capability_lifecycle
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Hashes existing broadcast credentials and gives them a fixed migration-time expiry of 180 days, changing long-lived external OBS access.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805040000_platform_superadmin_mfa
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Existing superadministrator refresh sessions have no MFA verification timestamp and fail closed when the required production MFA policy becomes active.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805050000_private_assets_and_screenshot_evidence
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Permanently removes legacy OCR sourceImages and sourceImageUrl values from stored match-control JSON without creating replacement private assets.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805060000_durable_manual_billing
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Changes the default for new organizations to EXPIRED while strict runtime entitlement rules require reviewed reconciliation of any inconsistent legacy organization states.

dataImpactMigrations.name: 20260805070000_widget_capability_lifecycle
dataImpactMigrations.reason: Hashes existing widget credentials and gives them a fixed migration-time expiry of 180 days, changing long-lived OBS widget access.
